library.rt_000:r_5fc8009a10283f8d.text:
A super robot that is the pride of the Takeo General Company, the jack-of-all-trades of space.
It normally stands by in the park with only the upper half of its head exposed. When a job comes in, it launches after a double safety check of the surroundings: first an announcement from the clerk $$郁絵$$ that begins with 'Sorry for the disturbance as always,' then $$ワッ太$$'s own call of 'Safety check!' It is a robot deeply rooted in its community.
It was originally put into operation by $$ワッ太$$'s father, Michitaro, to broaden the scope of the company's business, but he lost his life in an accident on the job. $$ワッ太$$ then took over as company president, and in doing so also inherited the pilot's seat.
Its greatest feature is that its base form, $$トライダーＧ７$$, can transform into as many as seven forms: the cruising form 'Trider Cosmic,' the heavy tank form 'Trider Beagle,' the fighter jet form 'Trider Eagle,' the small reconnaissance plane form 'Trider Hawk' (in which Trider's head separates from the torso and transforms), the surface and underwater form 'Trider Marine,' and the vehicle form 'Trider Mobile.'
At first glance it appears to be unarmed, but it stores numerous weapons within its body, including the 'Vulcan Missiles' fired from its fingertips. Each weapon is deployed instantly at $$ワッ太$$'s call, becoming Trider's great strength. Its strongest finishing move, the 'Trider Bird Attack,' wraps Trider in a Bird Beam that spreads out from the bird emblem on its chest, then rams into the enemy at high speed to tear it apart. It consumes a tremendous amount of energy, but its power is immense.
It boasts enough performance to have repelled every mecha-robot sent by the Robot Empire in its bid to conquer Earth, and fittingly, its creator was Navarone, a former scientist of the Robot Empire. He built Trider both to repay his debt to Michitaro, who had once saved his life, and to fulfill his own dream of creating 'a robot with a heart' -- a dream he achieved. But $$ワッ太$$ and the others knew Navarone only as Umemoto, an ordinary Earthling, and never learned the truth of his identity, or that of the Robot Empire, until the very end.
Note that operating Trider requires a 'Robot License' -- not just anyone can pilot it.

library.rt_000:r_fee437bed0c74d09.text:
A space transport ship operated by the Takeo General Company.
As with the old $$シャトル$$, every employee except $$ワッ太$$ boards it, dividing up duties from piloting to weapons control.
The old $$シャトル$$ was heavily damaged in battle with Jackal, an executive of the Robot Empire, but was rebuilt with funding from the Director-General of the Space Defense Agency, gaining upgrades across the board in firepower, cruising speed, and more.
Its role remains unchanged: it combines with Trider's cruising form, Cosmic, to become the Fortress, and its main uses are transporting supplies and personnel. But thanks to reinforcements better suited for combat, it has become an even more reliable support machine for Trider.
For the managing director, too, the results of the refit -- improved work efficiency without denting the company's own pocket -- seem to have been thoroughly satisfying.
Though its exterior changed dramatically, the interior remains much as it was before. The dining salon is still in place, and the homely atmosphere of the workplace, with employees gathering around the table together, has not changed either.

library.rt_000:r_faad6f8fa908c2c4.text:
A robot conceived and designed by Dr. Kaneda, and completed by Dr. $$敷島$$.
It is operated by Rainbow Waves transmitted from $$正太郎$$'s Vision Controller, commonly known as the V-Con.
It is equipped with a solar energy conversion system that grants it a virtually unlimited operating time so long as there is sunlight, and an independent linkage system that lets it keep moving even if part of its body is destroyed. It also boasts a top flight speed of Mach 4.02, an underwater cruising speed of 40 knots, and a ground speed of up to 300 km/h, along with sensor lights incorporating radar equipment that let it operate in darkness -- making it capable of activity anywhere, space included.
In keeping with Dr. Kaneda's philosophy of it being a messenger of peace, it carries no dedicated weapons, but the hammer punches and flying kicks it unleashes with its sturdy super-alloy body are each devastating blows.
For all its high performance, its one weakness is that whether it does good or evil depends entirely on its remote control. When villains have seized the V-Con, it has carried out destructive acts exactly as they directed.

library.rt_000:r_3326853417a812e4.text:
A robot conceived and designed by Dr. Kaneda, and completed by Dr. $$敷島$$.

In the final battle, it released all of its solar energy at once, defeating the Space Demon King at the cost of itself. $$正太郎$$ was plunged into grief, but before long the V-Con responded again, and it returned safely.

library.rt_000:r_762ac63151f051e5.text:
A robot with a will of its own, developed in Gang X's underground factory.
It was originally meant to have the entire brain of its creator, Dr. Franken, copied into it, but the copying process was cut short after only one hundred-thousandth of it was complete, leaving it with the intelligence of a three-year-old.
It rivals $$鉄人$$ in power, speed, and other measures of performance. Its eyes can also fire a powerful electromagnetic beam that stops any mechanical device.
After Dr. Franken was killed by Gang X, it was entrusted to Dr. $$敷島$$ for a time, but Gang X's Gangal disguised himself as Dr. Franken and issued it orders, forcing it into battle against $$鉄人$$.
After Gangal was defeated, it began fighting alongside $$鉄人$$ of its own will, becoming a reliable ally.

library.rt_000:r_ce5c27bf2dc85ddd.text:
A robot with a will of its own, developed in Gang X's underground factory.
It was originally meant to have the entire brain of its creator, Dr. Franken, copied into it, but the copying process was cut short after only one hundred-thousandth of it was complete, leaving it with the intelligence of a three-year-old.
It rivals $$鉄人$$ in power, speed, and other measures of performance. Its eyes can also fire a powerful electromagnetic beam that stops any mechanical device.
After Dr. Franken was killed by Gang X, it was entrusted to Dr. $$敷島$$ for a time, but Gang X's Gangal disguised himself as Dr. Franken and issued it orders, forcing it into battle against $$鉄人$$.
After Gangal was defeated, it began fighting alongside $$鉄人$$ of its own will, becoming a reliable ally.
It later received education from Dr. $$敷島$$, and its manner of fighting and behavior showed growth. When $$鉄人$$ was cornered by $$グーラ$$, it rushed in dashingly and saved him from that crisis.
It threw itself into the battles that followed as well, but after having a hypnosis device attached to it, it lost its sense of self and once again became $$鉄人$$'s enemy. The device was destroyed in the fighting and it came back to its senses, but in trying to make up for its own mistake it fought recklessly, and in the end it met its demise.

library.rt_000:r_da3b33a0f6acb978.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 2, 'The Stolen $$鉄人$$!'
The second robot built by the Robot Mafia led by Branch, constructed at their undersea hideout.
$$正太郎$$, who had fallen into Branch's trap and had his V-Con stolen, and $$大塚$$, who had likewise been taken captive, instead seized this machine and escaped in it.
Piloted by $$大塚$$, it faced off against $$鉄人$$ No. 28, controlled by Branch, but stood no chance at all.

library.rt_000:r_4b98b80cf6da7bbb.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 2, 'The Stolen $$鉄人$$!'
The second robot built by the Robot Mafia led by Branch, constructed at their undersea hideout.
$$正太郎$$, who had fallen into Branch's trap and had his V-Con stolen, and $$大塚$$, who had likewise been taken captive, instead seized this machine and escaped in it.
Piloted by $$大塚$$, it faced off against $$鉄人$$ No. 28, controlled by Branch, but stood no chance at all. However, the battle was cut short when $$正太郎$$ cornered Branch, and it powered down without being destroyed.

library.rt_000:r_44ead4450a866673.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 25, 'The Space Demon King Appears!'
The first Space Robo confirmed by Earth, with the appearance of a giant monster.
It fires a powerful mysterious red beam by crossing its antennae. It can also curl into a sphere to form a defensive posture that reinforces its armor, and in this form it completely blocked $$鉄人$$'s attacks.

library.rt_000:r_bfaf192f3ad6209c.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 25, 'The Space Demon King Appears!'
The first Space Robo confirmed by Earth, with the appearance of a giant monster.
It fires a powerful mysterious red beam by crossing its antennae. It can also curl into a sphere to form a defensive posture that reinforces its armor, and in this form it completely blocked $$鉄人$$'s attacks. But $$正太郎$$ turned that against it, hurling the Space Robo into a giant saucer. Once its defensive form broke, it charged in head-on, but was defeated by a flying kick.

library.rt_000:r_8af3edbe9ec72dcb.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 26, 'Branch's Final Moment.'
The second Space Robo sent out by the Space Demon King's army, with the appearance of a beetle.
Since it was $$正太郎$$'s first battle in outer space, he was unfamiliar with the conditions and was forced into a difficult fight.

library.rt_000:r_ecad969258cbd6f6.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 26, 'Branch's Final Moment.'
The second Space Robo sent out by the Space Demon King's army, with the appearance of a beetle.
Since it was $$正太郎$$'s first battle in outer space, he was unfamiliar with the conditions and was forced into a difficult fight. However, thanks to advice left behind by Branch -- who, in his final moments, realized he had been used by the Space Demon King -- $$正太郎$$ found a way through, and the Space Robo fell before $$鉄人$$'s fierce onslaught.

library.rt_000:r_cade0f7500a291f5.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 31, 'The Fortress Comet Attacks!'
The third Space Robo sent by the Space Demon King. It broke its body apart into separate parts and mixed them in among meteor fragments to descend to Earth. It repeatedly combined and separated its parts at will to dodge $$鉄人$$'s attacks.
In the end, $$鉄人$$ caught it in a moment of separation, breaking into its body with a Rolling Attack, and it exploded.

library.rt_000:r_23cf424f79dd9416.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 48, 'Earth's Greatest Crisis!'
The fifth Space Robo, piloted personally by $$グーラ$$, with the appearance of a lion.
It has performance surpassing every previous Space Robo, and the sword-shaped beam it fires from its mouth is unmatched in power, easily piercing even $$鉄人$$'s super-alloy armor.

library.rt_000:r_1b5515b6234576d4.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 48, 'Earth's Greatest Crisis!'
The fifth Space Robo, piloted personally by $$グーラ$$, with the appearance of a lion.
It has performance surpassing every previous Space Robo, and the sword-shaped beam it fires from its mouth is unmatched in power, easily piercing even $$鉄人$$'s super-alloy armor.
It drove $$鉄人$$ to the very brink of defeat, but was blocked by the arrival of Black Ox, and fell before their combined attack.

library.rt_000:r_c22f1172e450faac.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 50, 'Prince $$グーラ$$ Dies!'
The seventh Space Robo, piloted by $$グーラ$$ after he resolved on a final battle with $$正太郎$$, with the appearance of a Western knight.
$$グーラ$$'s specialty, the sword attack, is powerful, and he also uses tricks such as hurling boulders with an electromagnetic net fired from his fingertips. It fought a fierce battle against $$鉄人$$ on the surface of the Moon.

library.rt_000:r_12388fb0efb52558.text:
A robot that appeared in Episode 50, 'Prince $$グーラ$$ Dies!'
The seventh Space Robo, piloted by $$グーラ$$ after he resolved on a final battle with $$正太郎$$, with the appearance of a Western knight.
$$グーラ$$'s specialty, the sword attack, is powerful, and he also uses tricks such as hurling boulders with an electromagnetic net fired from his fingertips. It fought a fierce battle against $$鉄人$$ on the surface of the Moon.
In the end, its sword was seized by $$鉄人$$ and it was cut in two by its own weapon.

library.rt_000:r_984b9b791c366e3b.text:
A small saucer used by the Space Demon King's forces.
It typically launches from a giant saucer and attacks its target in formations of several units.

library.rt_000:r_a9f255bd1eccd141.text:
A giant saucer used by the Space Demon King's forces.
It can carry numerous small saucers as well as Space Robos inside it.
It has been commanded not only by General Majin, a subordinate of the Space Demon King, but also, on occasion, by Branch, who was lent it by the Demon King himself to direct an attack.

library.rt_000:r_a6c543848e2758b6.text:
The demon king who rules the universe.
He was once human, but when his home planet was swallowed by a black hole, his will to live caused him to merge with it, and he survived as this being.
His personality is coldly merciless, and he rules the universe through fear and violence.

library.rt_000:r_6ecdec25af1fd87b.text:
The demon king who rules the universe.
He was once human, but when his home planet was swallowed by a black hole, his will to live caused him to merge with it, and he survived as this being.
His personality is coldly merciless, and he rules the universe through fear and violence. Yet toward his son $$グーラ$$, he sometimes showed the warmer face of a parent.
At first he intended to swallow Earth whole in one stroke, but was talked out of it by $$グーラ$$'s pleading. However, when $$グーラ$$ lost his life in his showdown with $$鉄人$$, the Demon King burned with rage and unleashed cataclysms upon the Earth.
When $$正太郎$$ and the others plunged into the Dark Sun at the black hole's core, he converted the power of his conviction into energy and appeared before them, driving $$鉄人$$ to the brink with overwhelming force.
In the end, he was annihilated along with the Dark Sun when $$鉄人$$ unleashed the full force of its solar energy.

library.rt_000:r_f14cc53a44932035.text:
A super robot that could be called Earth's guardian deity.
When $$タケル$$'s Gaiar falls into danger, the $$ゴッドマーズ$$ emblem appears on the screen inside the cockpit. Taking this as the signal that combination is possible, $$タケル$$ begins the sequence with a cry of '$$ゴッドマーズ$$!' Five robots fly in from different locations around the world -- the Sphinx, which houses Gaiar, from Egypt; Uranus, which becomes the right arm, from the Arctic; Titan, which becomes the left arm, from the Indian Ocean; Shin, which becomes the right leg, from Angkor Wat; and Ra, which becomes the left leg, from Easter Island -- and combine with Gaiar in the Six God Combination to form $$ゴッドマーズ$$, a body of super-alloy Positronium powered by anti-proton energy.
Its weapons are not especially numerous: God Fire, fired from the 'G' mark on its abdomen, and Mars Flash, a great sword given physical form from the same 'M' mark. However, since their power scales with $$タケル$$'s psychic abilities, they are more than sufficient in combat. The flip side is that they are also at the mercy of $$タケル$$'s mental state, and there were times when prolonged fighting and exhaustion sapped their power and led to a hard-fought battle.
Even after combining, each of the component robots can separate again, and scenes of them attacking with their own individual weapons or in hand-to-hand combat have also been seen.
Its finishing move is 'Final $$ゴッドマーズ$$,' which cleaves the enemy in two by combining Mars Flash with God Fire.

In the final battle against the revived $$ズール$$, it received the prayers of many people and shone gold, unleashing supernatural power.

library.rt_000:r_c51809db1c711b75.text:
A fighter plane crewed by the Crusher Team.
$$ケンジ$$ commands, $$アキラ$$ pilots, $$ナオト$$ and $$タケル$$ handle attacks, and $$ミカ$$ is in charge of communications and reconnaissance. After $$ロゼ$$ pledged her cooperation to $$タケル$$ and the others, she too boarded the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ and took over attack duties in $$タケル$$'s place.
It is an all-purpose machine capable of long-duration flight and operation both inside and outside the atmosphere. In peacetime it served as the Crusher Team's transport, while in battle it worked tirelessly in every capacity, from direct combat against enemy fighters to supporting Gaiar and $$ゴッドマーズ$$.
It is formed by the combination of Unit 1, which becomes the fuselage and nose, and Unit 2, which becomes the rear section and main wings. It also carries a small Unit 3 inside it, and the 'Triple Laser,' in which all three units separate to attack from four directions at once, is a coordinated attack unique to the close-knit Crusher Team.

library.rt_000:r_c78267ead7aa9da2.text:
A combat mecha that appeared in Episode 51, '$$ズール$$ Appears!'
It appeared before $$タケル$$ after he had been fitted with a Devil Ring.
It is notable for its two snake-like heads, but carries no particular armament, attacking instead by charging.
It showed a charging power that did not weaken even under a hit from Mars Flash, but was defeated by a counter Final $$ゴッドマーズ$$.

library.rt_000:r_9193b43ea6038738.text:
A combat mecha that appeared in Episode 57, 'Are You the Knight of the Rose...?!'
It emerged from among the asteroids approaching Earth and attacked the Crusher Team, piloted by the Gestalt members Snapper and Nakker.
It jammed the summoning of the five god robots with a brainwave-blocking beam fired from its head, cornering Gaiar as it was left unable to combine into $$ゴッドマーズ$$.
However, it was struck in the head by the sudden attack of the Knight of the Rose, cutting off the brainwave-blocking beam. Once it allowed the combination into $$ゴッドマーズ$$, it was destroyed in an instant.

library.rt_000:r_a35880cf4c261c33.text:
A combat mecha that appeared in Episode 54, 'Farewell! $$タケル$$ and $$ロゼ$$.'
Piloted by the Gestalt member Bode, it fires a scorching beam from its chest that generates magma. It lurked on the seabed near Greenland, intending to sink all the world's land beneath a boiling sea.
It drove Gaiar into a corner, caught between the undersea battle and the torment of the Devil Ring.
It was defeated by $$ゴッドマーズ$$, who combined with the support of Uranus -- capable of freezing even magma -- and in the end sank to the bottom of the sea.

library.rt_000:r_081c360d554055fb.text:
A combat mecha that appeared in the final episode, 'A First Smile for the Galaxy.'
It appeared before the Crusher Team as they headed out to investigate the waters off the Hawaiian Islands.
All six members of the Gestalt ride aboard it, and a large-caliber beam is fired from its underside.
It fended off the $$コスモクラッシャー$$ when it interposed itself between the mecha and Gaiar, but was defeated before $$ゴッドマーズ$$. Immediately afterward, the Gestalt members who leapt out from inside it gathered together, and $$ズール$$ was fully revived.

library.rt_000:r_ea9df22e0530930d.text:
An AT developed by the Gilgamesh forces.
It stands as the archetypal AT, highly versatile, with numerous modification parts and usable weapons available for it. It is also excellent in terms of production efficiency, and its total production numbers are very high.
It is equipped with everything that would become standard on later ATs, including the fixed arm punch weapon and the gliding wheels on its legs.
Its greatest feature, the triple turret lens on its head, combines standard zoom, wide angle, and precision aiming, and rotates to switch between them as the situation demands.
Note that this version is the one that was carried aboard the space battleship X, and shows a slight improvement in performance compared to the standard model.
AT is short for 'Armored Trooper,' and its pilots are often called 'AT riders.'
AT riders are also sometimes called 'VOTOMS riders.' VOTOMS means 'the lowest of bastards,' a slang term coined to mock the pilots put into weapons whose survivability was cut down in exchange for higher production efficiency. There is also a theory that VOTOMS is an acronym for 'Vertical One-man Tank for Offence and Maneuver.'
It is the machine $$キリコ$$ used most, but apparently not out of any particular attachment or fondness -- simply because he was used to it and it was easy to get hold of.
Incidentally, from its model number, 'ATM-09-ST,' ATs directly descended from the $$スコープドッグ$$ are sometimes called the '09 series.'

library.rt_000:r_5c4936ad8b248448.text:
The state of a $$スコープドッグ$$ fitted with a Round Mover pack.
The Round Mover is a vernier-equipped mission pack for operating 09-series ATs in outer space. Its acceleration and operating time fall short of dedicated space fighters, making it unsuited to long-range incursions, but the thruster units extending in every direction grant high maneuverability and allow 360-degree movement in space, making it a highly versatile piece of equipment.
09-series ATs can also be fitted with the Parachute Pack, used for atmospheric drop operations. Between the two, they can carry out operations across a wide range of environments, from outer space down to the ground.

library.rt_000:r_71176d61332d99e5.text:
A color variant of the $$スコープドッグ$$ used by the Melkia Regional Army.
Thanks to its excellent versatility, the $$スコープドッグ$$ exists in far more than just different paint schemes -- there are also variant machines such as the 'Marshydog,' for use in water and wetland combat, and the '$$バーグラリードッグ$$,' for use in rough terrain.
Melkia, incidentally, is the planetary nation at the core of the Gilgamesh Stellar Federation, having risen to the status of leading planet thanks to its achievement of developing ATs in the closing days of the Third Galactic War (the Hundred Years War). The Melkia Regional Army is its own dedicated planetary force.

library.rt_000:r_4779b8aa1705c824.text:
An AT assembled in Gomor, the capital of the planet Quent.
The 'DT' in its name stands for 'Desert-Trip.'
It carries unique, high-performance equipment, including a Quent-element metal detection sensor with extremely high target-tracking ability, a pile bunker mounted on its left arm, and a dedicated assault rifle.
Like other Berserga units, it has been customized to suit the battlefield it is deployed to, and this particular unit has been fitted with a sand-tripper unit for desert warfare.
This machine is a restoration of an old unit that had been sitting in a storage center -- 'a wreck, but a quality one,' in the words of $$ゴウト$$, who handled the refit.
It is originally a machine used only by mercenaries from Quent, but with $$シャッコ$$ injured, $$フィアナ$$ boarded it instead and pursued $$キリコ$$, who had become Wiseman's successor.

library.rt_000:r_8e1968a00d317603.text:
An AT developed by the Balarant Army to counter the Gilgamesh forces.
'$$ファッティー$$' is a derogatory nickname used by the Gilgamesh side; its official Balarant designation is Frogger.
The stubby, barrel-like build that gave rise to the nickname is the result of an unsuccessful attempt to miniaturize its power plant and rocket propellant tanks, though it did produce good results in terms of heavy armor.
It is not equipped with a roller dash mechanism, but carries verniers at various points, including a large rocket nozzle on its back and units on its shoulders, waist, and soles, achieving high spatial maneuverability. Built around group combat as its basic tactic, it fought Gilgamesh ATs, which individually outperformed it, to a standstill.
Its main weapon is a recoilless catapult launcher, with options such as the Hard Bread Gun also available.

library.rt_000:r_61dd02b7de659989.text:
A general-purpose fighter operated by the Balarant Army.
It is mainly used for combat within the atmosphere, but can also operate outside it.
It is originally an interceptor, but is also used for missions such as reconnaissance.

library.rt_000:r_8d11adf91da93db6.text:
A wheeled small armored vehicle operated by the Balarant Army for use against ATs.
It is used for a wide range of purposes, from combat and support with its twin 37mm cannon to troop transport.

library.rt_000:r_f3ccb5965d4a0c6f.text:
A $$スコープドッグ$$ customized by $$キリコ$$.
In order to counter Niiba's $$エクルビス$$, it has had its armor thoroughly stripped down to reduce weight. Its resistance to gunfire has dropped sharply, but combined with the major weight reduction and additional gliding wheels, it achieves high mobility and high maneuverability.
Its shoulders have been deliberately painted red to provoke Niiba, who bears a grudge against the Red Shoulders.

library.rt_000:r_2875e8afbcb2e256.text:
A $$ＰＳ$$-exclusive AT developed by the Balarant Army.
Its control systems are wired directly into the pilot's nervous system, giving it phenomenal maneuverability.
The base machine was the $$秘密結社$$'s Strikedog, making it a unit that gathers together the AT development technologies of both the Gilgamesh and Balarant forces.
It has missiles and machine guns built in, but carries no handheld firearms, relying mainly on close combat with the pile bunker on its right arm and the crab claw on its left.
In the town of A-Kova, a prototype unit gathered real combat data by taking part in Battling, going by the ring name 'Danger Melon.'

library.rt_000:r_3f597475865697de.text:
A ground battleship developed by the Balarant Army.
A type that emphasizes its function as a mothership over gun firepower, it functions largely as a mobile base.
In the early days of the Hundred Years War it achieved results on the ground that could be called invincible, but it eventually faded from use due to its high construction costs and the changes in tactics brought about by the rise of ATs.
Niiba, burning with obsession to bring down $$キリコ$$, wired the control system directly into his own brain just as with the $$エクルビス$$, operating the massive vessel as an extension of his own body.

library.rt_000:r_33f9f717c6c37c90.text:
A variant of the $$スコープドッグ$$, a type built for rough-terrain combat.
It is notable for its leg-mounted Trample Rigger, suited to crossing bad terrain, and the Droppers Folding Gun on its back, which enables long-range shooting.
Excelling in both firepower and off-road performance, it was the machine $$キリコ$$ used for his single-handed assault on Allegium, the holy land of the $$マーティアル$$.

library.rt_000:r_e727642da6781c23.text:
A custom AT exclusive to the 13th Rank of the Pan-Galactic Society $$マーティアル$$, the 'Shield of Order.'
A custom machine based on the $$エルドスピーネ$$, it uses high-performance parts throughout, giving it performance far beyond comparison to the original machine, and letting it keep up with the reaction speed of $$テイタニア$$, a $$ネクスタント$$.
It is equipped with an electromagnetic pile bunker integrated into its shield, and displays unmatched strength in close combat.

library.rt_000:r_b0da23abc04016c3.text:
An AT used by the Pan-Galactic Society $$マーティアル$$.
Developed with the sole purpose of defending the holy land of Allegium, it is designed with movement through the forests and stone architecture around the holy land in mind.
It carries unique equipment: the Seilspyde, which fires a harpoon called the Harpune, and the Spinlad, which reels it back in. With these, it is capable of hoisting itself up and down, and of handling movement along the vertical axis as well.

library.rt_000:r_c3e4f5d7214516d4.text:
The machine completed when Kei's beloved Bronco II, badly damaged, was repaired and, in the process, reinforced and modified using Emaan technology.
The legs of the Bronco II were kept as they were, but at Kei's request -- having taken a liking to the handling when he piloted the Molabar -- its arm units were fitted on. Furthermore, in addition to the sympathetic system, three inertial control systems, two anti-gravity levitation units, and a nuclear reactor with output approaching 500,000 horsepower were installed, and despite being a hasty patchwork job, the result surpassed the performance of conventional Drifados. Thanks to this high performance, a mass-production model was later developed as well.
Another major feature is its Variable Geometry ability, allowing it to take four different forms to suit the situation: its humanoid form, the Orguroid, along with Fighter, Gerwalk, and Tank forms.
When it was completed, the members of the $$ファクトリー$$ discussed what to call the new Bronco II, with everyone throwing out their own suggestions, from 'Valhalla' to 'Gammon.' In the end, $$ファクトリー$$ member Jabby settled on '$$オーガス$$,' taken from the name of a war god from the world he originally came from.
Incidentally, 'Nebulado,' one of the names put forward, was the show's working title back in its planning stages.

library.rt_000:r_ee8207e70f8fc923.text:
A transformable mobile suit developed by Anaheim Electronics for the $$エゥーゴ$$.
A machine that represents the culmination of the know-how cultivated through the Zeta Project, it was completed by combining the $$ガンダムＭｋ－Ⅱ$$'s Movable Frame technology with the concept of Flying Armor.
The adoption of Gundarium gamma armor plating and a new-model generator gives it an excellent power-to-weight ratio, achieving unrivaled mobility. Its high output also makes it possible to use the Hyper Mega Launcher, a portable weapon whose power rivals even the Mega Bazooka Launcher.
It can also transform into the $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$, granting it tremendous cruising range and acceleration. It is a machine capable of performing in every scenario, from single-handed atmospheric entry and solo flight within the atmosphere to operations carrying an escort unit on its back.
Later, a Bio-Sensor -- a simplified psycommu system -- was installed, giving it a tracking response matched to $$カミーユ$$'s finely honed reflexes. It has also been observed to display inexplicable phenomena not included in its specifications, such as interfering with and stopping the movements of enemy mobile suits.

library.rt_000:r_ebb29f0677520d89.text:
$$Ｚガンダム$$'s cruising form.
It is used as an air and space combat fighter and can also carry an escort unit on its back, but its greatest feature is its ability to enter the atmosphere on its own.
It is called the $$ウェイブ・ライダー$$ because it gains lift from a compressed shock wave formed on the underside of the machine.

library.rt_000:r_4ad52065feebe6ec.text:
A mobile suit independently developed by the $$ティターンズ$$ at Grips.
It is a redesign of the original Gundam, but its greatest feature is that it did away with the Core Block System in favor of the Movable Frame. This allowed for movement much closer to that of a human body, achieving high mobility. Other new technologies incorporated throughout the machine include a linear-seat cockpit with an all-around monitor and a detachable Vulcan Pod System.
After it was seized from the $$ティターンズ$$ by $$カミーユ$$ and the others and joined the $$エゥーゴ$$, its color scheme was changed from black to white.
Its main armaments are the Beam Rifle, Beam Saber, Long Rifle, Hyper Bazooka, and others.

library.rt_000:r_3113eda502e87de6.text:
The $$エゥーゴ$$'s first transformable mobile suit, developed by Anaheim Electronics.
As a machine built to verify the transformation mechanism for the Zeta Project, its combat ability is low, and its airframe strength is not especially high either.
It was deployed aboard the Argama and operated by Reccoa and $$ファ$$.
Two units appeared in the film, and were active in various scenes.

library.rt_000:r_8f10ec354fa5c3e6.text:
The $$エゥーゴ$$'s first transformable mobile suit, developed by Anaheim Electronics.
Its performance in Mobile Suit form is mediocre, but in Mobile Armor form it excels in mobility and acceleration, and it has been seen using its speed to run circles around enemies.

library.rt_000:r_7fe26c6d5aa93969.text:
A Newtype-exclusive mobile suit developed by $$アクシズ$$.
It was developed under the design philosophy of turning the old Principality of Zeon's mobile armor, the Elmeth, into a mobile suit. It is equipped with funnels, a development of the remote-attack bits.
Its psycommu is also used not only to control the funnels but to control the machine itself, achieving a high degree of responsiveness.
Its other armament is a beam gun that doubles as a beam saber.

library.rt_000:r_78b7e5332197599a.text:
A mass-production transformable mobile suit developed by $$アクシズ$$.
Originally based on the Gaza A and Gaza B, used for development and construction work, it was developed into a transformable mobile suit with combat capability. In Mobile Armor form, it attacks with Knuckle Buster bombardment and anti-ship attacks using its leg claws. Its mobility and close-combat ability are low, and its basic tactic is group bombardment from long range. On the other hand, its production efficiency is high, and it is mass-produced at $$アクシズ$$'s shipyards.
Because $$アクシズ$$ and the Earth Federation Forces once allied for a time, it carries designation numbers from both militaries: $$アクシズ$$'s AMX-003 and the Federation's MMT-1.
Aside from those above, its other main armaments are a beam gun and a beam saber.
